task.title: Publish apps/kanban to GitHub Packages
task.description: Enable installing claude-kanban into any repo with `npx @mattfletcher94/claude-kanban`. Package stays private - only accessible to those with GitHub repo access.
task.problem: Currently there is no way to install claude-kanban into other repositories. The package is not published to any registry. Users cannot run npx to set up kanban in their projects. This blocks adoption and distribution of the kanban tooling to other codebases.
task.value: - Enables private npm-compatible distribution via GitHub Packages - Uses existing GitHub authentication and repository permissions - Free for private packages (500MB storage, 1GB bandwidth) - Standard npx workflow familiar to developers - No separate registry account required
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the apps/kanban package When I examine package.json Then the name is "@mattfletcher94/claude-kanban" And publishConfig.registry points to "https://npm.pkg.github.com" And repository.url matches the GitHub repo And a prepublishOnly script runs the build
Given the apps/kanban/bin/install.cjs file When I examine the constants and help text Then PACKAGE_NAME reflects "@mattfletcher94/claude-kanban" And help text shows the correct npx command
Given the root package.json When I examine the scripts Then there is a "kanban:publish" script And running it publishes to GitHub Packages
Given a user with GitHub repo access And they have configured ~/.npmrc with the GitHub Packages registry and PAT When they run "npx @mattfletcher94/claude-kanban" Then the package installs and runs successfully
Given a user without GitHub repo access When they try to install the package Then they receive an authentication error (package is private)
